title: A filled rectangle and a filled oval
concept: Rectangle and Oval as pure vector frames: a FillColor swatch makes each shape paint without any text or image content.

annotations.note: A Rectangle with FillColor="Color/Red". No ParentStory, so the parser files it as a vector frame, not a text frame. ContentType="GraphicType" declares it a graphics frame.
An Oval with FillColor="Color/Blue". The parser treats it as the ellipse inscribed in its path's bounding box.
The four PathPointType anchors describe a 240x240 square; the inscribed ellipse is therefore a circle.
